brief: The canvas presents a partially assembled jigsaw puzzle viewed from above. Numerous interlocking pieces, ranging in color and shape, fill the space, forming a recognizable image when complete. Pieces that are disconnected float within the frame, waiting to be placed. The core interaction involves moving the loose pieces and snapping them into their designated slots. When two or more pieces correctly interlock, the seams where they join glow with a faint, visible light, highlighting the connection. This glow intensifies slightly when the full puzzle is completed, drawing the viewer's eye across the assembled image.

Revise: the same jigsaw puzzle, and this time the seams where pieces interlock glow faintly when they snap into place.
statement: This sketch presents an interactive jigsaw puzzle experience viewed from above. The canvas displays numerous interlocking puzzle pieces of varying shapes and colors floating within the frame. Users can click and drag loose pieces to move them around the canvas. When pieces are positioned close enough to their correct neighbors, they automatically snap together and form connections. The seams between correctly connected pieces glow with a subtle light effect that intensifies when the entire puzzle is completed. This creates an engaging visual feedback loop where users can see their progress as they assemble the image, with the glow serving as both a functional indicator of successful connections and a celebratory highlight when the final piece is placed.
